author: visegrad24
text:
This is an important post to understand how tonight’s German regional election was won by the far-left Linke party (25%)

The picture shows Linke’s Turkish Bundestag member Ferat Koçak with the Palestinian Hamas-supporter Ibrahim Ibrahim at Linke’s election night party in the immigrant neighbourhood Neukölln.

Ibrahim is a famous Berlin activist who appears as a representative of the United Palestinian National Committee (VPNK). 

According to Germany’s federal domestic intelligence agency, VPNK is a label under which Hamas supporters and PFLP supporters jointly organize protests and events in Berlin.

Ibrahim has also publicly praised Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar as a “steadfast leader” and “fighting martyr hero.” 

Ibrahim writes under his picture taken with the Linke MP Ferat Koçak at tonight’s Linke election party in Neukölln that VPNK was “part of this success.” He’s taking credit for Linke’s strong result in Neukölln and Berlin. 

Another key figure that attended tonight’s Linke election party in Neukölln, and was seen talking with the Hamas supporter Ibrahim, is the Mhallami Arab Issa Remo.

He’s the leader of the Remmo clan, an extended family and large criminal organization consisting of around 100 gangsters and several hundred more family members who, even if not active gangsters themselves, aid the criminal family members in various ways.

Some of them work as lawyers, local politicians, judges and even police officers.

Issa Remmo has strong links to Neukölln.

The Remmo clan is linked to a number of murder investigations in Germany and is behind several high-profile crime cases such as:

- The Dresden Green Vault Heist in 2019

One of the largest art theft in modern history. Clan members disabled the streetlights of Dresden by setting an electrical distribution panel on fire and then broke into the Historic Green Vault museum, stealing 18th-century jewelry containing more than 4,300 diamonds, worth $130 million. 

- The Bode Museum Gold Coin Theft in 2017

The clan broke into the Bode Museum in central Berlin, stealing a massive solid gold coin issued by the Royal Canadian Mint. 

The coin weighed 100 kilograms (220 lbs) and was valued at $4.4 million. 

They wheeled it out on a wheelbarrow and dropped it onto the train tracks below to a getaway car. 

- The Sparkasse Bank Robbery in 2014

Remmo clan members broke into a Sparkasse bank branch in Berlin-Mariendorf.

They forced open over 100 safety deposit boxes, making off with $11.3 million in cash, gold and jewelry.

The set the bank on fire to cover destroy any DNA evidence but one clan member was sentenced due to a face mask not burning up.

To summarize, the far-left Die Linke party won the Berlin election tonight.

3 men attended Die Linke’s election night party in the immigrant neighborhood Neukölln

- A Turkish Member of Parliament
- A Palestinian Hamas-supporting protest leader
- A Mhallami Arab crime boss and clan leader

This is the future of local and regional politics in many cities in Western Europe…
